design_notes: Use serif font throughout; single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Financials table: hairline rules between rows, bold header row, right-align numbers.
Pull-quote: set in larger serif italic, with a thin rule above and below, accent colour for the rule.
Sidebar: box with thin border, light background tint, compact type.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration. Indian Railways, the company's largest customer, contributed 57% of revenue in FY2018.
pull_quotes.quote: Majority of our revenues will be dependent on one customer, Indian Railways, which is our largest customer, contributing to 57% of our revenue in Fiscal 2018.
pull_quotes.rationale: Single most important risk factor; a sharp, damning number that prose cannot carry.
